note: Typical ranges reported by US appliance repair cost guides in 2026 (parts and labor). Not quotes. The exact price is given after diagnosis.

items.name: Diagnostic visit
items.detail: Usually credited toward the repair when you go ahead.

items.name: Washer repair
items.detail: Drain pumps, lid locks and door boot seals sit at the lower end.

items.name: Refrigerator repair
items.detail: Fans and defrost parts cost less; sealed-system work costs more.

items.name: Dryer repair
items.detail: Thermal fuses and belts are among the cheapest repairs.

items.name: Oven and range repair
items.detail: Bake elements and igniters are common; glass cooktops cost more.

items.name: Dishwasher repair
items.detail: Pumps and inlet valves are the usual parts.
